==Description==
'''Broke''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Hidden Enemies]] and before [[Healthy Enemies]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match.

==Effects==
When applied, all sources of income are reduced by 50%.

==Update History==
*'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]]
**'''Broke''' added.
**{{Bug}} Despite claiming to reduce income by 33%, it actually reduces it by 50%.
*'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]]
**Reward boost increased from +20% to +30%.
**{{Bugfix}} Description now displays the correct reduce income value.
